title: Ohio court says lawyers must prove fair fees after client secures $250,000 car settlement herself
summary_full: Amber Kopanski settled her car crash claim directly with Progressive Direct Insurance Company for $250,000 after parting ways with her lawyers. Her former law firm, Rumizen Weisman Co., Ltd., sought payment for its legal fees and costs after her settlement. The appeals court ruled that the firm cannot simply apply its contract percentage for payment determination.
